svg.title: Timeline of language models and music LLMs, 2017–2026
svg.desc: Solid chips are models, dashed chips are methods and benchmarks. 2017: Transformer | music: -; 2018: GPT-1, BERT | music: -; 2019: GPT-2, T5 | music: -; 2020: GPT-3, Retrieval-Augmented Generation | music: -; 2021: WebGPT | music: -; 2022: Emergent Abilities, Chain-of-Thought, RLHF, ChatGPT | music: -; 2023: Claude 1, Gemini 1, LLaMA, Qwen, ReAct, Toolformer, HuggingGPT, Reflexion, Generative Agents, DPO | music: LLark, MU-LLaMA, MusiLingo, SALMONN, MusicAgent; 2024: SWE-agent, MCP, GRPO | music: ChatMusician, MuChoMusic, MMAU; 2025: DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, Gemma 3, Kimi K2, Nemotron 3, Search-R1, Automated Design of Agentic Systems | music: TalkPlay, Amuse, Nota, LLaQo, Music Flamingo, TalkPlay-Tools, LLM2Fx-Tools, CMI-Bench, MusiQAl, MusiXQA, RUListening, MMAR, MMAU-Pro, NotaGen, YuE, MIDI-LLM; 2026: Agentic Context Engineering, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5, Gemini 4 Argon | music: Metadata LLMs, MuseAgent-1, MIDI-LLaMA, Qwen-Music, YuE2
